credits.title: The Paragon
credits.overview: The victim of a hit and run learns to be psychic so he can take revenge on the driver that hit him. A comedy where revenge is a cosmic experience.

credits.title: Mizutani Isao's Wanderings through Ten Spiritual Worlds
credits.overview: Sage’s world is riffled with an anxiety disorder that impedes all elements of her life. We follow her journey of isolation and raw existence. She's well practised at suppressing all signs of the illness but on a trip away with friends, her best friend becomes the catalyst for change.

credits.title: Things Are Going Really Well
credits.overview: Costumed in a wig and mustache, Violet visits the man she has been seeing in an attempt to understand his sudden coldness towards her.
